heroHeadline: Gangs Ambush UN-Backed Force in Croix-des-Bouquets; El Salvador Sends Special Forces After Four Troops Go Missing
heroSubtitle: On October 18 gangs attacked a Salvadoran Gang Suppression Force armored vehicle with explosives, the force's first major attack since operations began; four Salvadoran technicians are missing and El Salvador has deployed about 200 special forces. Haiti remains on course for elections on December 13.
